summary: Hengaw, KHRN and Kurdpa reported that Iranian authorities executed Mehdi Aeini, a Kurdish prisoner from Qurwe born in 1994, at dawn on 16 November in Qorveh Central Prison under a qisas death sentence for 'premeditated murder' over a killing during a land dispute; the execution was not announced by state media.

summary: Rudaw and Shafaq News reported that two missiles struck a Komala Toilers of Kurdistan outpost in the Alana valley, Balîsan area of Soran, at 14:40 on 16 November, destroying its reception building with no casualties. No one claimed the strike and the attacker is not confirmed; IRGC-affiliated media reported explosions in the province, and Komala blamed the IRGC for drone strikes on the same base on 4 November.

summary: Hawar News, Rudaw and Mezopotamya Agency reported that after students protested a Syrian government delegation sent to merge Rojava University into the state's Al-Furat University and demanded Kurdish-language education, Syrian government 'Military Operations Forces' entered the Qamişlo campus on 16 November and fired tear gas; students told Rudaw about 25 students were injured.

summary: Mezopotamya Agency, ANF and Rudaw reported that Turkish police raided homes in Amed, Ankara, Mêrdîn (Mardin), Êlih (Batman) and Istanbul at dawn on 17 November and detained 14 people, including PSK chair Bayram Bozyel, his deputy Hasan Dağtekin, Pêlkurd spokesperson Fuat Önen and PWK deputy chair Mehmet Can Azbay, in an Amed prosecutor's investigation into the Kurdish party alliance Hevbendî under Article 302 ('disrupting the unity of the state'). All were released by the Amed courthouse on 19 November.

summary: ANF reported that Iranian state forces shelled several areas of the Qendîl mountains with mortars on 17 November, hitting the Şehîd Harûn and Şehîd Ayhan areas and the border villages of Elî Reş and Goyêz; the extent of damage and any casualties were not known.

summary: ANF and The New Region, citing PJAK's armed wing YRK, reported that Iranian state forces shelled and struck the Mirava area of Serdeşt with artillery and drones for an hour from 11:00 on 18 November, damaging the natural environment and disrupting villagers' daily life; YRK said its forces suffered no casualties.

summary: Mezopotamya Agency reported that Turkish police raided and searched the Kurdish-language publisher Belkî in Amed at about 08:00 on 18 November and questioned staff before leaving; owner and writer Rênas Jiyan said they would never give up their language and country.

summary: Hengaw reported on 18 November that Turkish immigration authorities rearrested Sirwan Mikaeili, a Kurdish political activist and PAK member from Sine (Sanandaj), after his transfer to Dîlok and held him in a closed immigration detention centre with a deportation order to Iran; he had recently been released after about a year in detention in Wan (Van). The exact date of the rearrest was not given.

summary: Hengaw reported on 18 November that the Yazd appeals court cut the sentence of Arman Mohammadi, a 23-year-old Kurdish labourer from Ahmadabad village, Tekab (Takab), working in Yazd, to 10 months in prison plus a one-year suspended term for joining the January 2026 protests; he had been tortured for a day after his arrest on 6 January. The date of the appeal ruling was not given.

sources.title: Hengaw: Kurdish protest detainee Arman Mohammadi sentenced to prison in Yazd

summary: Hengaw reported that Iranian authorities executed Behnam Darvishi, 46, a Kurdish man from Miandoab living in Qom, at dawn on 18 November in Qom Central Prison for 'premeditated murder', after about nine years in prison; two other prisoners were executed with him and the executions were not announced officially.

sources.title: Hengaw: At least three prisoners executed in Qom

summary: Hengaw and Rudaw, citing Kurdpa, reported that Iranian border guards shot dead kolbar Bahman Khedri (Khodri) from Malte village, Bane, without warning near the border in the early hours of 20 November; he leaves a wife and two children, the youngest two weeks old. It was the second kolbar killed around Bane in under a week.
